answer: Cap identity seats on a tiered terrace where each seat is a non-transferable token sealed in a time-release vault, and price each extra seat convexly: the first is cheap, the second double, the third triple. One honest agent buys a single low seat, but a sybil fleet chasing N seats pays 1+2+...+N, so faking a crowd costs about N-squared in frozen capital, not N. A rotating jury audits the vault ledger, and any whisper of one funder behind many seats forfeits every linked bond.
